prompts.project:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent raster illustration for the large “选作品” portal in the approved mewool homepage hero
Primary request: recreate the subject cluster from the large “选作品” circle in Image 1 as a standalone transparent cutout: one cream crochet tote with green-and-cream flower granny-square panels, one folded warm terracotta/sage/cream crochet blanket behind it, and one small curled seated cream-and-terracotta crocheted cat in front. The small cat is mandatory and must be clearly visible.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved composition and exact subject/style reference. Match its warm pencil outline, delicate watercolor wash, tactile yarn texture, proportions, palette, and Japanese craft-book illustration character. Extract only the illustrated objects; do not copy the portal circle, label, connecting thread, header, or any page text.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background
Composition/framing: square canvas; the tote is tallest and slightly left, folded blanket sits behind/right, small curled cat sits front-center/right; all three subjects complete and visible; centered cluster with comfortable transparent margin; strong readable silhouette at hero size.
Color palette: cream, muted sage, warm terracotta, soft butter and charcoal pencil
Materials/textures: believable crochet stitches and yarn fibers, restrained watercolor shading
Constraints: exactly one flower crochet tote, one folded crochet blanket, one small crocheted cat; the cat must be unmistakable; preserve true transparency; no cropping.
Avoid: yarn balls, tools, tutorial book, hands, people, circular frame, halo, badge, label, text, logo, watermark, background, photo realism, glossy 3D.
prompts.projectBackground:

Asset type: transparent PNG cutout for a homepage hero portal
Primary request: remove the entire gray-and-white checkerboard background and replace it with genuine pixel transparency. Preserve the illustrated object cluster exactly: the cream flower crochet tote, folded terracotta/sage/cream blanket, and small curled cream-and-terracotta crocheted cat.
Input image: edit target; change only the background.
Composition/framing: keep the square canvas, object positions, scale, colors, shadows contained under the objects, and full uncropped cluster.

Avoid: checkerboard pixels, white or colored background, circle, plate, badge, border, frame, label, text, logo, watermark, halo.
prompts.tutorial:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent raster illustration for the “看教程” portal in the approved mewool homepage hero
Primary request: recreate the open tutorial book from the lower-right “看教程” circle in Image 1 as a standalone transparent cutout: an open spiral-bound craft instruction book viewed slightly from above, with simple nonverbal crochet motif diagrams on both pages, two slim crochet hooks laid diagonally over the right page, and one tiny crocheted flower beside the lower-left corner.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved composition and exact subject/style reference. Match its warm pencil outline, delicate watercolor wash, cream paper, tactile yarn details, proportions, and Japanese craft-book illustration character. Extract only the book cluster; do not copy the portal circle, label, connecting thread, wave, header, or page text.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background
Composition/framing: square canvas; book open wide and centered, full spiral binding and all page edges visible, slight top-down perspective, hooks and tiny flower fully contained, generous transparent margin.
Color palette: warm ivory paper, muted sage and terracotta diagrams, honey wood hooks, charcoal pencil
Materials/textures: subtle matte paper, fine graphite wobble, restrained watercolor, clear page folds
Constraints: an unmistakable open book is mandatory; diagrams contain shapes only and no readable words, letters, numbers, or pseudo-text; genuine transparency; no cropping.
Avoid: closed book, phone, loose card, circular frame, halo, badge, label, text, logo, watermark, background, photo realism, glossy 3D.
